author: Antigravity
name: DualSense
shortDescription: Full DualSense & DualSense Edge integration over USB and Bluetooth.
description: Adds the DualSense / DualSense Edge features, connection supported over USB and Bluetooth. Works alongside the built-in Gamepad extension (which still handles the normal buttons and sticks).
